comments.body:
Findings on the current delivery (report vs. results/figure):
1. report.md says "No fit uncertainties were computed" and gives all-n slopes 1.89/0.99, but results/slopes.csv (9aa2edf) has 95% CIs (insertion n>=2000: 2.03 [1.97,2.09]; merge n>=2000: 1.14 [1.10,1.19]; all-n 1.90 [1.83,1.96] / 0.99 [0.92,1.06]) and the figure legend shows them. Report the CIs, drop the stale caveat, and make report slopes match slopes.csv/figure (2.03 not 2.02; 1.90 not 1.89).
2. summary.csv's loglog_slope column (1.8935, 0.9936) disagrees with slopes.csv (1.8956, 0.9921); the report cites summary.csv for slopes. Cite slopes.csv, and ask experiment-repo to fix the column.
3. The merge n>=2000 CI excludes 1.0; say explicitly that this is consistent with n log n (local exponent ~1.1) rather than linear, and quantify if possible (e.g. expected n log n slope over 2000-16000).
Figure and table otherwise check out.
